title: Closed component-saturated residue equalizers for pro-affine etale targets
statement: Let X be a scheme, let U and W be objects of its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and suppose that U to X is pro-affine etale [sk-def-pe-morphisms], namely a small cofiltered limit of absolutely affine etale X-schemes. For X-morphisms p,q:W to U, put E={x in W: fromSpecResidueField(x) followed by p equals fromSpecResidueField(x) followed by q}, with residue fields as in [def-weil-residue-field]. Then E is closed and contains the entire connected component of each of its points. Moreover, for every object V and X-morphism f:V to W whose underlying point map has image contained in E, the scheme morphisms f followed by p and f followed by q are equal. No reducedness assumption on V or W is imposed.

source.place: docstring of completedAffineFree_localDual_detect: clopen equality into each affine etale stage and equality into their limit; expanded by the explicit diagonal pullback in ProAffineEtaleResidueEqualizer.lean

proof.text: Unpack the pro-affine etale presentation of U as a limit D. Composing p and q with its limit projections gives pairs of maps over X to the absolutely affine etale stages D(j).

At a stage t:D(j) to X, pull its diagonal back along the paired map from W to D(j) times_X D(j). The diagonal is open by the Mathlib formally-unramified diagonal instance and closed by the separatedness instance for morphisms from absolutely affine schemes; both immersion properties persist under pullback. Hence the resulting map e is a clopen immersion. Its image is exactly the residue-field equality locus: a residue equality yields a lift by the pullback universal property, while a residue point in the image factors through the open immersion and therefore equalizes the arrows. Any map with image in this locus factors through e by IsOpenImmersion.lift and consequently equalizes the pair. This argument concerns scheme maps and does not assume reducedness.

By IsLimit.hom_ext, residue equality into U is equivalent to residue equality at every stage. Thus E is the intersection of the stage clopens. An intersection of closed sets is closed; a connected component meeting a clopen is contained in it, so E is component-saturated. A map into E equalizes every stage pair by the preceding open-immersion factorization. A second use of IsLimit.hom_ext proves equality into U. The argument also applies to empty test schemes and empty equality loci.

proof_origin.note: Fully proved geometric sublemma, not a new hole. Pullback and open-immersion lifting use existing Mathlib APIs.
